description: Client-side script for managing buying transactions in ERPNext, including purchase order handling, item queries, address management, and product bundle integration.

classes.name: BuyingController
classes.description: Controller class for managing buying transactions, extending erpnext.TransactionController with custom logic for purchase workflows.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initial setup for the BuyingController, calling parent setup.

methods.name: onload
methods.description: Handles form load event, setting queries and default values.

methods.name: setup_queries
methods.description: Configures query filters for various form fields based on current document state.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Refreshes form UI, toggles display elements, and sets up product bundle button.

methods.name: toggle_subcontracting_fields
methods.description: Enables or disables subcontracting related fields based on document type.

methods.name: supplier
methods.description: Fetches supplier details and applies price list.

methods.name: supplier_address
methods.description: Displays supplier address and sets taxes based on address.

methods.name: buying_price_list
methods.description: Applies selected buying price list to items.

methods.name: discount_percentage
methods.description: Resets discount amount and updates price list rate.

methods.name: discount_amount
methods.description: Resets discount percentage and updates price list rate.

methods.name: qty
methods.description: Calculates received quantity for items and calls parent method.

methods.name: rejected_qty
methods.description: Calculates rejected quantity for items.

methods.name: calculate_received_qty
methods.description: Calculates and sets received and stock quantities for an item.

methods.name: batch_no
methods.description: Calls parent method for batch number handling.

methods.name: validate_negative_quantity
methods.description: Checks if item quantities are negative and shows message if so.

methods.name: warehouse
methods.description: Fetches warehouse bin details for an item.

methods.name: project
methods.description: Assigns project to other items if one item has a project set.

methods.name: rejected_warehouse
methods.description: Auto-fills rejected warehouse details.

methods.name: category
methods.description: Recalculates taxes and totals if tax category changes.

methods.name: add_deduct_tax
methods.description: Recalculates taxes and totals after tax adjustments.

methods.name: set_from_product_bundle
methods.description: Adds a button to fetch items from a product bundle.

methods.name: shipping_address
methods.description: Displays shipping address details.

methods.name: billing_address
methods.description: Displays billing address details.

methods.name: tc_name
methods.description: Fetches terms and conditions.

methods.name: update_auto_repeat_reference
methods.description: Updates auto-repeat document reference.

methods.name: manufacturer
methods.description: Fetches manufacturer part number for an item.

methods.name: manufacturer_part_no
methods.description: Validates manufacturer part number.
